authoringStatus: reviewed simplified candidate; photographic registration and hidden appearance unresolved
assumptions: Photographic features unregistered; opening dimensions remain inferred author proportions.
Seed geometry fingerprint is a cache digest, not an externally certified revision.
Exact owner footprint and all semantic surfaces retained; stock flat roof placeholder must not replace source-derived rear volumes in a promoted reconstruction.
No source crop datum or pixel height is treated as an independent measurement.

The dated full crop establishes the keyhole aperture, central recessed middle balcony, repeated right yellow balcony doors and the ground mailbox bank. Source plane mapping locates facade features; width/height/colour/setback remain visually inferred, without photographic metric registration.
The central recessed back is dark and obscured: no unsupported back glazing or joinery is asserted. A closed plain inset wall and .80 m depth are explicit appearance inferences.
The far-right ground frontage is hidden by vegetation. No invented window is added there. Native roof surfaces, overall height and rear volumes remain exact; hidden appearance is unresolved.
